focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 学术演讲（Tech Talk）/ 顶会审稿回复（Rebuttal）/ 科研个人陈述（SoP）（BP41–BP48）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 学术演讲开场 60 秒 Hook：用直观痛点或反直觉现象抓住全场（Oral Opening Hook）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想作为顶会 Oral Presentation、组会汇报或博士面试 PPT 第一页的开场白：在 45–60 秒内不用任何晦涩公式，让全场听众立刻听懂“我们为什么要做这件事、现有方法到底卡在哪”。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: Tech Talk / Conference Oral / 组会开场逐字稿（Slide 1–2）
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [场景直觉切入 Concrete Scenario Hook]：Good morning everyone. Imagine deploying a humanoid robot to assemble flexible cables on a moving factory line—or forecasting grid load when a storm hits.
S2 [反直觉痛点设问 Counter-intuitive Breakdown]：Standard deep models perform remarkably well when conditions stay calm, yet why do they fail abruptly the moment contact dynamics or weather patterns shift?
S3 [一针见血揭晓答案 Crisp Root Cause]：The culprit is a hidden stationarity assumption baked into standard attention layers.
S4 [亮出今日主旨 Talk Roadmap]：In this talk, I will show how our framework, [Model Name], breaks this bottleneck and achieves [Key Metric Gain] in real-time deployment.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Concrete Visual Scenario -> Rhetorical Question -> Crisp Culprit Identification -> Talk Promise. 绑定逻辑规则：L018, L029.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: Hello everyone, my name is XXX. Today the title of my presentation is 'Adaptive De-stationary Spectral-Spatial Transformer for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting'. First I will talk about background, second methodology, third experiments, and finally conclusion.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 最催眠的开场方式：念一遍长标题 + 报一遍八股目录（First background, second methodology...），台下听众前 30 秒就开始看手机。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Good morning everyone. Suppose you are operating a regional wind-power grid when a sudden cold front sweeps across the turbines. Standard Transformer forecasters look accurate during calm weather, yet why do their predictions lag by hours right when the storm hits? The culprit is instance normalization: in trying to stabilize attention weights, it strips away the exact amplitude surges needed to predict peak loads. In the next five minutes, I will show how our model, DyTS-Net, resolves this trade-off—cutting extreme-weather forecasting error by 17% while running twice as fast.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: AI/CS 小论文：Abstract 与 Introduction 立意与破题（BP01–BP08）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 挑战与机制一对一映射段（Challenge-to-Mechanism Mapping）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想说明：把我们的核心思想落地时遇到了两个具体工程/数学难点，我们分别设计了什么精巧机制去攻克它们。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: Introduction 第四段或 Methodology 开篇总览段
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [落地难点总起 Implementation Hurdle]：Translating this principle into a scalable architecture entails two technical challenges.
S2 [难点 1 + 靶向设计 1]：First, because [Challenge 1], we design [Mechanism 1] to [Specific Function].
S3 [难点 2 + 靶向设计 2]：Second, to prevent [Challenge 2] under [Constraint], we introduce [Mechanism 2] that [Specific Function].
S4 [整体计算/泛化特性 System Property]：Together, these components enable [Model] to operate at [Efficiency/Robustness Metric].
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Challenge 1 -> Mechanism 1; Challenge 2 -> Mechanism 2 -> Joint System Property. 绑定逻辑规则：L003, L011.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: There are two challenges. The first challenge is that noise is big. We use a filter. The second challenge is that speed is slow. We use distillation.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 全部是散装幼稚短句（is big, is slow, We use...），毫无学术机制深度。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Instantiating closed-loop visuomotor diffusion on physical robots entails two technical challenges. First, because raw depth camera streams contain occlusion artifacts around reflective object edges, we introduce a tactile-guided cross-attention gate that reweights visual tokens upon contact onset. Second, to eliminate the 200 ms sampling bottleneck of iterative denoising, we formulate a trajectory consistency distillation objective that maps Gaussian noise directly to collision-free action chunks in two forward steps. Together, these designs sustain 50 Hz reactive control under partial visual occlusion.

paragraph_move_structure: S1 [视觉坐标锁定 Spatial Pointer]：Let's look at the comparison in the right panel of Slide 5, where the horizontal axis tracks prediction horizon and the vertical axis shows MSE.
S2 [引导观察反方崩溃曲线 Guide to Baseline Curve]：Notice the dashed orange curve representing the standard Transformer baseline: past 336 steps, error shoots up almost vertically.
S3 [引导观察我方稳定曲线 Guide to Our Curve]：Now compare that with our solid blue curve at the bottom, which stays flat even out to 720 steps.
S4 [一句话点破视觉差距原因 One-Sentence Takeaway]：That gap comes directly from our neural-ODE scale tracker preventing long-range drift.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Spatial Coordinate -> Notice Baseline Failure -> Compare Our Curve -> One-Sentence Mechanistic Takeaway. 绑定逻辑规则：L018, L015.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: Here is Figure 3. You can see many lines here. Our model is the blue line and it is the lowest, which means our model is the best on all horizons.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 没有给听众任何坐标引导（You can see many lines here），听众还在找坐标轴是什么意思时你已经翻页了。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Let's focus on the right panel of Slide 6, which plots forecasting error as the prediction window stretches from 96 to 720 hours. Follow the dashed orange curve for iTransformer—notice how rapidly the error climbs once we pass 336 hours. Now compare that against our solid blue curve along the bottom, which remains nearly flat all the way to 720 hours. That 17% gap at the far right comes directly from decoupling phase attention from continuous scale tracking.

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 段落内主语瘦身与尾重平衡（Subject Compression & End-Weight）
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 在多句段落中，严禁出现超过 10–12 个单词的臃肿主语从句或连环 of 短语作主语（头重脚轻）。把已知的短核心名词放在主语位置（≤6 词），将复杂的条件、机制和结果顺延到谓语动词之后的宾语或状语从句中。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: Bad: [The phenomenon that A with B under C fails to D] is common. -> Good: [Short Subject A] frequently fails to [Verb D] when [Condition B and C occur].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 受中文“……的现象/问题/事实表明……”影响，写出 The fact that... is... 或 The problem of the degradation of... is... 的畸形句。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: The phenomenon that autoregressive language models hallucinate unverified citations when prompted with out-of-distribution academic queries is a serious obstacle.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Autoregressive language models frequently hallucinate unverified citations when prompted with out-of-distribution academic queries, posing a serious obstacle to automated literature review.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 主语从 17 个词压缩为 3 个词（Autoregressive language models），强动词 hallucinate 提前，句尾用分词结果状语自然收束。

focal_logic_rules.category: Rebuttal & Peer Review (审稿回复逻辑)
focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 顶会 Rebuttal 黄金四步：致谢认同 -> 结论前置 -> 新增证据/表格 -> 修订位置锚定
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 回复审稿人尖锐质疑时，绝不能情绪化辩解或绕圈子。第一句简短感谢并重申问题核心；第二句直接给出明确结论（Direct Answer）；第三至四句呈上新增实验数据或理论澄清（New Empirical Evidence）；末句指明已在修订稿哪一节哪一表更新。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: We thank Reviewer X for raising this insightful question regarding [Topic]. [Direct Answer: Our method maintains 84% success even under 30% occlusion]. Specifically, our new ablation in Table R1 shows that [Data]. We have incorporated this analysis into Section 4.3 (highlighted in blue).
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 用大段文字教育审稿人“你没看懂我们的论文”，或者只口头承诺“我们以后会做实验”而不给真实数据。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: You misunderstood our paper. We already explained this in Section 3. Our model is actually very robust to noise.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: We thank the reviewer for highlighting the question of sensor noise robustness. To verify performance under severe corruption, we evaluated our policy under Gaussian observation noise ($\sigma \in [0.05, 0.20]$). As shown in Table R2 below, our model degrades by only 3.2% at $\sigma=0.20$, compared with a 21.5% drop for the Diffusion Policy baseline. We have added these results to Appendix D.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 礼貌专业，直接用新增噪声区间实验数据（3.2% vs. 21.5% 跌幅对比）让审稿人心服口服。

focal_revision_cases.domain_zh: 顶会审稿回复（Rebuttal）与消融防御
focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想作为顶会 Oral Presentation、组会汇报或博士面试 PPT 第一页的开场白：在 45–60 秒内不用任何晦涩公式，让全场听众立刻听懂“我们为什么要做这件事、现有方法到底卡在哪”。

Today the title of my presentation is 'Adaptive De-stationary Spectral-Spatial Transformer for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting'. First I will talk about background, second methodology, third experiments, and finally conclusion.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L011 段落内主语瘦身与尾重平衡（Subject Compression & End-Weight））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 最催眠的开场方式：念一遍长标题 + 报一遍八股目录（First background, second methodology...），台下听众前 30 秒就开始看手机。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。

Standard Transformer forecasters look accurate during calm weather, yet why do their predictions lag by hours right when the storm hits? The culprit is instance normalization: in trying to stabilize attention weights, it strips away the exact amplitude surges needed to predict peak loads. In the next five minutes, I will show how our model, DyTS-Net, resolves this trade-off—cutting extreme-weather forecasting error by 17% while running twice as fast.

focal_revision_cases.domain_zh: 非平稳时间序列预测与分布漂移消除
focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想作为 Introduction 第一段：说明多变量时间序列预测或具身智能控制在实际工业系统中的关键作用，以及高可靠性的刚需。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: In the rapidly developing modern world, time series forecasting plays a pivotal role in many fields. The fact that industrial sensors often have noise and distribution changes makes forecasting very hard and bad for decision making.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L001 旧信息在前、新信息在后原则（Given-to-New Principle））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: ① 首句 AI 套话（In the rapidly developing... plays a pivotal role）；② 第二句严重头重脚轻（The fact that... 11词从句作主语）且用词口语化（very hard and bad）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。
focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Multivariate time series forecasting underpins safety-critical scheduling across smart power grids, cloud clusters, and automated manufacturing. In these operational settings, control systems rely on multi-horizon predictions to balance supply fluctuations and prevent cascading overload. However, field sensors routinely operate under abrupt regime shifts, irregular sampling intervals, and high-frequency measurement noise. Failing to accommodate such non-stationary disturbances degrades long-range forecast reliability and triggers costly control oscillations.

focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: To isolate the contribution of each design choice, Table 2 compares full DyTS-Net against three ablated variants across ETTm2 and ECL. Removing the neural-ODE scale tracker (w/o Scale-ODE) triggers the sharpest degradation during seasonal transition months on ETTm2, raising 720-step MSE by 19.4% as the decoder fails to track shifting baseline temperatures. Conversely, replacing phase-aligned graph attention with standard dot-product attention (w/o Phase-Attn) degrades performance most severely on the 321-channel ECL grid (+13.8% MSE), where unaligned high-frequency load spikes corrupt cross-substation aggregation. Jointly deploying both modules yields complementary gains, as accurate scale tracking prevents amplitude distortion from biasing phase estimation.
